blocks.text: Condo buildings in Beach Grove
Heron Cove — 1706 56 Street (directory address 1704 56th Street)

Built 2005 (building directory and an MLS listing agree). The directory records 52 units in this building, with bike room, elevator, guest suite and in-suite laundry. Restrictions per the directory: pets allowed with restrictions; rentals not allowed — that recorded line is void for long-term rentals under the Nov 24, 2022 rule in.
Windgrove (also listed as Windgrove Residence) — 1642 56 Street

Small low-rise building: the building directory (secondary source) records built 2006 and 12 units, with elevator, in-suite laundry and storage. Restrictions per the directory: pets allowed with restrictions; rentals allowed with restrictions (long-term rental restrictions are void in any case). A listing for a unit describes a pet-friendly building with no restriction on pet size — directory and listing do not match.
Tsawwassen Mews — 5622 16 Avenue
The corridor's oldest strata stock: the building directory's index records 3 levels, completed 1977, freehold strata title, filed under sub-area Beach Grove.
The Pillars (apartment component) — 1702 56 Street

MLS listings for penthouse units at this address record sub-type Apartment, built 1996, with elevator, underground and visitor parking, guest suite and in-suite laundry among the recorded amenities/features.
Where it sits and what to know here

items.t: A neighbourhood description (secondary source) borders Beach Grove by 19th Avenue, 56th Street, 12th Avenue and the banks of Boundary Bay.
Nearby areas: Tsawwassen Central to the west, Boundary Beach and Point Roberts (USA) to the south, Ladner to the north.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: not on the waterfront streets. The strata buildings stand on the 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor at the pocket's west edge; the Boundary Bay waterfront streets themselves are detached and duplex houses, including the RD2 zone the bylaw states is for waterfront lots in Beach Grove, with a 4,000 m² minimum lot size for subdivision confirmed at 1728 Beach Grove Road.

Transit: route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line). The 56 Street corridor buildings here sit on its path to the exchange.

Parks: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach, 570 Boundary Bay Rd (Metro Vancouver) — Dyke Trail, Savannah and Raptor trails, Cammidge House — and Diefenbaker Park, 5579 1 Ave, on the south side of Tsawwassen. Services sit back at the centre: Tsawwassen Library, 1321A 56 St; South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St; Thrifty Foods on the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall site (City-listed addresses 1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue, 1236 55 Street).

Delta zoning — number contested, flagged, not settled: City pages and amendment bylaws cite "Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017" (the bylaw whose). What is not contested: zoning is parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps, and the Beach Grove waterfront zone sheet RD2 states a 4,000 m² subdivision minimum for waterfront lots in Beach Grove.

Waterfront setback: Zoning Bylaw s. 6.2.3 sets a waterfront setback for lots fronting on Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue, under which a seawall may encroach into the minimum front setback; the bylaw states no Beach Grove flood construction level.

Dike and flood system: the Beach Grove shore faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure.
The "Beach Grove condo" is a corridor product, not a beach product. A buyer searching the page name expecting waterfront condos will not find one.

The 2.9 m number governs this shore. SD3 sets the habitable floor at 2.9 metres GSC datum with a 2.3 m minimum land elevation and a 7.5 m tidal setback — and the zoning bylaw, unusually, states no Beach Grove flood construction level of its own, so the FCL question goes to the permit area and the City, not the zoning text.
A seawall has its own rule here. Zoning Bylaw s. 6.2.3 lets a seawall encroach into the minimum front setback on Boundary Bay lots along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue.

The dike trail is the amenity, and it is a working dike. Boundary Bay Regional Park's Dyke Trail runs on the Boundary Bay dike system the City maintains as flood protection (over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure city-wide) — recreation on top of infrastructure, which is why foreshore work is permitted, not casual.

The old area-plan name still surfaces in City paperwork. A City report on 1728 Beach Grove Road described the property under the Tsawwassen Area Plan; the current OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan. Marketing or reports quoting a current "Tsawwassen Area Plan" are quoting an earlier document.
Health care: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd in Ladner, is the nearest hospital; Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

items.t: Hazard and flood rules (Beach Grove waterfront): Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands) in OCP Bylaw 8400, Appendix B, provides that no building be located with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, that the minimum land surface elevation around construction be 2.3 metres GSC datum, and that no building be constructed within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. The Beach Grove shore faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike; the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure. blocks.text: Beach Grove: streets and boundaries

items.t: Beach Grove is a waterfront pocket inside Tsawwassen, in the City of Delta, on the Boundary Bay side east of 56 Street. Its own landmarks are Beach Grove Elementary at 5955 17A Avenue and Beach Grove Park at 6051 17A Avenue.
South Delta Secondary at 750 53 Street is the public secondary school for Tsawwassen addresses, with catchments set by School District 37 (Delta) by street address.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is mainly detached houses on low, flat lots behind the Boundary Bay dike, split between shoreline homes on the bay and interior streets around 17A Avenue. Delta's Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), applies to the pocket.
Beach Grove Park and the elementary school share the 17A Avenue ground, so the interior streets orient to a school-and-park block rather than a commercial street.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Foreshore building levels are set by a hazard permit area, not by the dike alone.

A waterfront setback rule covers Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue. Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, section 6.2.3, sets that setback and allows a seawall to encroach into the minimum front setback, and the bylaw states no Beach Grove flood construction level.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The City carries out staged flood preparedness in Beach Grove every fall, a routine a summer buyer never sees.

Delta received a $2 million provincial grant in 2023 for Boundary Bay dike improvements, with a pilot raising a dike section by the airport between 72 Street and 88 Street — the same dike system that protects this shore.
The City operates over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure and 31 drainage pump stations across Delta, so drainage here is pumped infrastructure, not gravity alone.
Beach Grove Park sits beside the elementary school on 17A Avenue, so park and school traffic share one block.
A Beach Grove seawall repair was a named flood project: the Province funded replacement of a deteriorating, cracked seawall section in Beach Grove as part of its 2016 flood-mitigation work.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: development and new projects

items.t: Boundary Bay dike raising pilot, between 72 Street and 88 Street by Boundary Bay Airport, City of Delta — raising a dike section using fill from large Metro Vancouver construction projects; status: $2 million grant announced July 31, 2023, pilot to be initiated with that funding (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Beach Grove: costs and taxes

items.t: The one-line figure: Delta's 2026 flat-rate utilities total $1,658 for a single-family home.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: getting around

items.t: Route 601 is the Tsawwassen bus spine, and its Boundary Bay trips serve this shore. TransLink's timetable runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line).
The Dyke Trail is the walking and cycling link along the shore, running through Boundary Bay Regional Park at Centennial Beach south of the pocket.

blocks.text: Beach Grove: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check Hazard Permit Area SD3 for the specific lot before any build or addition, because its 2.9 metre floor level and 7.5 metre tidal setback can change a plan — the OCP sets the levels, but only a parcel check says whether the lot is inside the area.

The four apartment-condo buildings/components (Heron Cove, Windgrove, Tsawwassen Mews, The Pillars' apartment component) all stand on the 56 Street / 16 Avenue corridor; the waterfront streets are detached and duplex houses, including RD2 lots the bylaw describes as waterfront lots in Beach Grove.
faq.q: Is there a condo on the Beach Grove waterfront?

faq.a: Long-term, yes — every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw became invalid on November 24, 2022, whatever older directory or bylaw text says. Short-term rentals are different: a strata can still ban or limit them, so read the current registered bylaws.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Heron Cove unit if the directory says rentals are not allowed?

faq.a: Sources differ on the unit count. The building directory lists 52 units in the 1704 56th Street building, while a strata directory lists a 101-unit complex total (plan LMS2509). Confirm the count with the strata corporation.
faq.q: How many units are in Heron Cove — 52 or 101?

Hazard DPA SD3 sets a 2.9 m GSC datum minimum floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land surface elevation and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area for the Boundary Bay foreshore, and the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike maintained by the City of Delta; the cited zoning s. 6.2.3 also sets a waterfront setback for Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue and states no Beach Grove flood construction level. Whether a given lot falls inside SD3 is a parcel-level check.
faq.q: What flood rules apply to a waterfront home in Beach Grove?

faq.a: It sits behind a dike, but that is not the whole answer. The shore faces Boundary Bay behind the Boundary Bay dike maintained by the City as diking authority, and foreshore lots also fall under Hazard Permit Area SD3 floor and setback levels, so check the specific lot on DeltaMap and ask about any flood covenant on title.
faq.q: Is a Beach Grove house protected from flooding?

faq.a: Beach access is along the Boundary Bay dike and foreshore, with Centennial Beach in Boundary Bay Regional Park to the south. Metro Vancouver runs that regional park at 570 Boundary Bay Road, with the Dyke Trail along the shore, so the pocket's beach routine runs south to the regional park facilities.
faq.q: What beach access does the pocket have?

faq.a: Winter storms drive the closures. City flood-preparedness material for Beach Grove and Boundary Bay Village describes temporary works each fall, with beach access points secured with concrete blocks or sandbags against southeasterly winter storms, and a berm where no seawalls exist.
faq.q: Why do beach access points close in winter?
